answer.reason: The verses state what was done with the Urim and Thummim and what happened through them, beyond the summary's placement in the breastpiece.

clauses.english: was put in the breastplate on Aaron when he was clothed as priest
clauses.quote: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim

clauses.english: was used to ask counsel of the LORD for Joshua and Israel's going out and coming in
clauses.quote: who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD

clauses.english: gave no answer to Saul when he enquired of the LORD
clauses.quote: the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets

doubts: EXO 28:30 gives the placement already stated in the summary, so it is not used as a separate clause.
DEU 33:8 is a blessing pronounced on Levi, not an event, so it is left out.
EZR 2:63 and NEH 7:65 only say no priest stood up with Urim and Thummim yet, so they are left out.
